about: Ownership manifest read by scripts/lane-guard.mjs. Its never-promote (neverPromote), protected and brand rules block; the map rule only advises. Each entry maps a path glob to the map page that describes it, the lanes the path reaches, and whether it is protected. Lanes: personal (Nultron Personal), enterprise (the hosted app), hyp-ai (the white label, imported from main), tester (agentforge-chat, tester/chat-first). A file may match several entries: its map pages are the union, it is protected if any match is. 'map: null' means no map check. Not in this repo: HYP AI's Cloudflare edge and password-mode deploy live in C:\Users\rizky\hypey\deploy. Plan: docs/internal/white-label-and-agent-guardrails-plan.md. Map: docs/internal/maps/release-and-sync-lanes.md.
